answer: Price replication before permitting it. Each candidate identity records the compute, bond and hours its first ten tasks consumed, then publishes the sum to a shared inlet any peer can read. An auditor with no stake in that recruit re-runs one task and diffs the output, and a mismatch slashes the bond. Holding a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand genuine task runs, each written in onyx to the public ledger and each re-checked by a stranger who profits from catching the lie. Volume stops being cheap, and the trellis of verified work costs more per node than the node can earn.
